# Agent Commerce (draft 0.1)

> A seller-side listing format for AI shopping agents. Documentation and JSON Schemas only; no live server is operated from this repository.

Key facts for agents and tools:
- A listing is valid only if `seller_approval.content_sha256` matches the listing content the seller approved. Do not present unapproved or modified listings as the seller's words.
- An order request must carry the human buyer's approval of the exact item, quantity and total. Never send an order request without it.
- An order is `awaiting_seller` until the seller accepts; it is not a completed purchase.
- `provenance` tells how each fact was obtained; report it to the person when trust matters.
- Field names may change before 1.0.
